name: Natick Boathouse Summer Camps
description_short: Week long boating day camps on Lake Cochituate at the Natick Boathouse for ages 8 to 15. Campers spend about half the day sailing and the rest kayaking, canoeing and paddleboarding, with a three week Boating for Teens program for ages 13 to 15.
swim_waterfront_notes: Most counselors are Red Cross certified lifeguards, and the camp keeps one lifeguard or instructor for every 7 campers. Campers stay off the water on days when wind makes it unsafe and work on boating skills on shore.

sessions.name: Boating is Fun Week 2 (no camp Friday July 2, 20% off)
Boating is Fun Week 3 (no camp Monday July 5, 20% off)
Boating for Teens Session 1 (ages 13 to 15, three weeks, no camp July 2 or 5, 10% off)
Boating for Teens Session 2 (ages 13 to 15, three weeks)

notes: Boating is Fun Camp costs $580 a week full day or $355 a week half day; the two short weeks are 20% off (shown here as $464 full day). Boating for Teens costs $1,549 for three weeks, with Session 1 discounted 10%. Season passholders save 10% on Boating is Fun Camp. Registration for 2027 opens January 1, 2027.
